# `company.purchase_item_lines`

Immutable one-to-one item lines of a bill, with captured item, account, quantity, cost, job and billable facts.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + revision_id + document_line_id | — | document_lines.id | Revision-local purchase envelope owning this one-to-one item profile. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + revision_id + document_line_id | — | document_lines.transaction_id, purchase_profiles.transaction_id | Stable document owning this item line. |
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + revision_id + document_line_id | ix_purchase_item_lines_item | document_lines.revision_id, purchase_profiles.revision_id | Exact immutable purchase revision owning this line. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this purchase history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this purchase history. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_purchase_item_lines_item | items.id | Item bought on this line. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account debited by this line, captured from the item's own purchase account. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Positive quantity bought, in millionths of one unit. |
